messages:
Lina (PM): RetailAnalytics asked for a short "show-and-tell" for their execs: they need to explain a sudden +37% month-over-month inference spend and tie it to a few representative traces / error buckets. Proposed MVP in Console: small 'Cost Forensics' panel (top routes by est spend + change), error bucket sparklines, and 3 sampled trace envelopes per suspicious route. Keep PII out.

Ethan (Eng): I like minimal surface. For envelopes: send {trace_id, route, error_code, token_counts, model_profile, short_error_msg} only. No user IDs. Limit to 3 envelopes/route per day in UI.

Ravi (SRE): Operational checklist: default sampling 0.5% unless org pilot requests higher; retention 5d; per-org quota for envelopes; auto-throttle if envelope/sec > baseline * 4. Add an incident toggle to kill sampling fast.

June (Data): Estimation approach: tokens*model_rate + fixed overhead. We'll flag routes detected as embeddings-heavy and adjust multiplier. Also we can show a small confidence score and a note: "Estimate not for billing."

Kai (UX): UI idea: small inline explainer that says: "Why this route? -> shows delta drivers: tokens, model change, error spike." Keep copy concise for CFO. Add an affordance to request raw traces for compliance review (flows to SE).

Lina (PM): Launch criteria: (1) Cost Forensics panel shows top-5 delta routes + percent change, (2) At least one pilot org onboarded and validated (RetailAnalytics), (3) Trace envelopes appear for suspicious routes (<=3/day) with no PII, (4) No p95 latency regression for pilot, (5) Docs + in-UI tooltip.

Ethan (Eng): Feature-flag snippet: 
```yaml
console_features:
  cost_forensics: true
  trace_envelopes:
    enabled: true
    default_sampling: 0.005
    per_route_limit_per_day: 3
    retention_days: 5
```
Will implement lightweight proto <512B.

Ravi (SRE): Alerts to add: `console.forensics.envelope_surge` (threshold: org_envelopes/sec > 4x baseline), `console.forensics.p95_regress` (threshold: p95 > 1.2x baseline). Owners: Ethan -> backend + flag, June -> estimator + labels, Kai -> UI copy + mock, Ravi -> alerts + kill-switch, Lina -> customer pilot coordination.

AlertBot: New alert templates created: console.forensics.envelope_surge and console.forensics.p95_regress.
